newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-INDIA ON WAY TO VICTORY IN FINAL TEST.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-INDIA ON WAY TO VICTORY IN FINAL TEST.

text.p: India were heading for victory over South Africa in the third and final test after inspired bowling on the fifth and last day on Monday.
Set 356 to win, South Africa collapsed from their overnight four for one to 136 for seven at the rescheduled tea interval after a thunderstorm interrupted play.
South Africa were reeling at 76 for five when the storm drove the players off half an hour before lunch.
The umpires decided a resumption could be made with 45.3 overs remaining, but at the same time said there would still be a tea interval, one hour after the scheduled break.
During that time, South Africa plunged into more trouble when Javagal Srinath ripped out Shaun Pollock's off stump to send back the all-rounder for a fourth ball duck.

Leg-spinner Anil Kumble then reduced South Africa to 95 for seven when he found the edge of Dave Richardson's bat, the wicketkeeper being brilliantly caught by the diving Mohammad Azharuddin at first slip for seven.
South Africa's main hope of saving the game remains with Daryll Cullinan, who smashed 71 not out from 95 balls with nine fours and one six.
He was batting at the interval with Lance Klusener, 10 not out.
